title: Vietnamese Pepper Noodle Soup
description: A spicy and comforting noodle soup originating from Vietnam. This dish combines the flavors of peppery peppers with the kick of Vietnamese chili, served in a savory broth.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add Vietnamese chili peppers and cook for another minute.
Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and add soy sauce, fish sauce, and brown sugar.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes, until the broth is flavorful.
Cook kicked noodles according to package instructions.
To assemble, place noodles in a bowl, then add the hot broth and toppings.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
